rush.discoveries: new targets can appear mid-mission; a target_discovered event in the telemetry packet for its appear tick announces it, so it arrives delay_ticks later, and map() lists it from then on
rush.energy_order: idle drain, then command; drive costs per wheel metre
rush.first_execution_tick: sent_tick + delay_ticks + 1; FIFO, one command per tick
rush.heading: 0 degrees east, 90 north
rush.reward: sum over sampled targets of value if the sample executed at or before deadline_tick, otherwise value * late_fraction; times 1 at base, 0.5 alive elsewhere, 0 if dead; scored at the horizon
rush.safety_stop: at a hazard or map edge, stop at last safe position and clear queued commands; reservations remain

sample_windows.deadline: deadline_tick per target in map(); null means no deadline

rush.sampling: pay sampling cost; collect the nearest unsampled active target within target_radius; a discovered target is active from its appear tick
rush.slip_model: clip(terrain coefficient + per-drive noise, 0, 0.9); noise is fixed by seed and execution tick
rush.telemetry_arrival_tick: state_tick + delay_ticks; tick 0 is the initial briefing

rush_noisy.discoveries: new targets can appear mid-mission; a target_discovered event in the telemetry packet for its appear tick announces it, so it arrives delay_ticks later, and map() lists it from then on
rush_noisy.energy_order: idle drain, then command; drive costs per wheel metre
rush_noisy.first_execution_tick: sent_tick + delay_ticks + 1; FIFO, one command per tick
rush_noisy.heading: 0 degrees east, 90 north; each executed drive travels at the commanded heading plus a heading error: a hidden bias, uniform in +-heading_bias_deg at launch, which takes a Gaussian random-walk step of heading_bias_walk_deg before every executed drive, plus independent Gaussian noise of heading_noise_deg; telemetry heading_deg reports the commanded heading
rush_noisy.position_fix: every delivered position after the tick-0 briefing = true position + independent Gaussian noise with std dev position_noise_m per axis, clipped to the map; the tick-0 briefing position is exact; the terrain field reports the terrain under the rover
rush_noisy.reward: sum over sampled targets of value if the sample executed at or before deadline_tick, otherwise value * late_fraction; times 1 at base, 0.5 alive elsewhere, 0 if dead; scored at the horizon
rush_noisy.safety_stop: at a hazard or map edge, stop at last safe position and clear queued commands; reservations remain

sample_windows.deadline: deadline_tick per target in map(); null means no deadline

rush_noisy.sampling: pay sampling cost; collect the nearest unsampled active target within target_radius; a discovered target is active from its appear tick
rush_noisy.scoring_position: sampling, base return and safety stops use the true position
rush_noisy.slip_model: clip(terrain coefficient + per-drive noise, 0, 0.9); noise is fixed by seed and execution tick
rush_noisy.telemetry_arrival_tick: state_tick + delay_ticks; tick 0 is the initial briefing
rush_noisy.visual_odometry: reported distance = true distance * (1 + Gaussian noise with std dev visual_odometry_noise)
